Credential-free checks — CI

hosted.label: Hosted demo
hosted.note: Ask a question and read the report, citations, terminal status, steps used, and trace. The hosted copy runs the loop over the committed fixture retriever, so it proves the agent's contract and says nothing about retrieval or answer quality; it sets no PRODUCTION_RAG_URL, so the HTTP retriever fails there with capability_missing by design.

hosted.label: Hosted demo
hosted.note: The same free path with no clone and no key: GET /health is open and POST /v1/code/ask answers with path:line citations. It indexes the committed mini and production_rag fixtures and nothing else, so it cannot answer about an arbitrary repository.

aiSystems.name: AI Platform
aiSystems.summary: A service gateway for the portfolio with API-key authentication, per-key rate limits, request-ID propagation, aggregate health, and compose-based operations — now hosted, so the gateway answers over HTTP without a clone.

evidence.label: Open health, gateway contracts, and release boundary — SHIP
Free path is the gateway only: it does not run P1–P4 for the visitor
Upstream URLs are empty in CI, so the four services report unconfigured
The dev-local demo key is a public fixture, not a credential
Rate limiting is an in-process fixed window on one instance, not a distributed limiter
Hosted on Vercel from the entrypoint shims in api/index.py and main.py
Credential-free mocked checks — CI
Published v0.1.0 release

hosted.label: Hosted gateway
hosted.note: Open the status console, or call it directly: GET /health is open, and GET /v1/platform/status needs the public demo header X-API-Key: dev-local. The hosted instance is the gateway only - it does not run P1-P4 for the visitor, so those four services report unconfigured.

capture.alt: AI Platform status page reporting the four upstream services as unconfigured
capture.caption: The gateway is honest when nothing is behind it: four upstreams, unconfigured.

capabilities.title: Delivery & trust
capabilities.description: Quality gates, explicit failure modes, and evidence that survives outside the author's laptop.

principles.title: Evidence over adjectives
principles.copy: A capability is linked to code, a test, a release, or a runnable path. Planned work stays visibly planned.

principles.title: Failure is a product state
principles.copy: Refusal, degradation, budget exhaustion, and dependency failure are modeled explicitly instead of hidden behind a successful response.

principles.title: Free path first
principles.copy: Core demos run without credentials or billed calls, so reviewers can inspect the whole system rather than trust screenshots.
